contradictions.explanation: xu2022graph claims GNNs outperform tabular models by 12–18 pp AUC-PR, while bolton2001statistical claims velocity features retain 85% of neural-model signal — these figures imply different absolute performance gaps and cannot both be precisely correct on comparable benchmarks.

liu2021pick asserts that self-paced sampling yields the largest gains under extreme class imbalance (>1:500), whereas carcillo2018scarff reports that streaming retraining frequency dominates sampling strategy in reducing missed fraud on concept-drifting streams — the two findings conflict on the primary lever for improving recall.
